description: This file defines the core interface and template class for a resource monitoring system within the Thunder project. It includes the IResource interface, the ResourceMonitorType template class managing resources with platform-specific worker implementations, and the singleton ResourceMonitor class. The file handles cross-platform socket and thread management, and integrates watchdog functionality for resource monitoring.

classes.name: IResource
classes.description: Interface representing a resource with a descriptor handle, event notifications, and a handle method.

classes.name: ResourceMonitorType
classes.description: Template class managing a set of resources, with platform-specific worker threads, monitoring, and resource registration/unregistration.

classes.name: ResourceMonitor
classes.description: Singleton class providing access to the resource monitor instance.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ResourceMonitor.
